statement: Intel reported Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin of 40.4% and non-GAAP gross margin of 41.8%
why: It shows how much of Intel's growth is turning into profit, with no prior-period margin given here to judge the direction.

impact.mechanism: Margin at this level while revenue grows 25% indicates cost and capacity intensity in foundry and packaging is still weighing on profitability.

evidence.excerpt: Gross margin: '40.4%' GAAP; '41.8%' non-GAAP for Q2 2026

confidence.basis: Reported directly in Intel's primary results release.

dispersion: GAAP 40.4% vs non-GAAP 41.8%; GAAP loss per share of $(2.16) against non-GAAP EPS of $0.42.
